pokedexEntries.su: This beautiful form reflects Magearna’s appearance when first presented to a king’s daughter 500 years ago.

pokedexEntries.mo: This gorgeous Magearna looks as it did at the time of its invention. Its luxurious decoration pleased the king’s daughter.

pokedexEntries.us: This is its form from almost 500 years ago. Its body is nothing more than a container—its artificial heart is the actual life-form.

pokedexEntries.um: It functions thanks to its artificial soul. The vivid decoration is proof that it was presented as a gift to royalty.
